title: Tree Select Readback
summary: Reads a nested checkbox selection back in plain words and tells a whole-group tick apart from ticking every item today.
description: Nested checkbox tree that reads the choice back in plain words ("All of Marketing except Paid ads; 3 of 12 in Sales"), tells a whole-group tick apart from ticking every item, and warns that a whole-group tick includes items added later, with a one-tap pin to today's items.
catches: Whole-group selections that will include future items
Groups partly selected, read back as "3 of 12"
A pin-to-today option that converts a group rule to today's items
limits: Future-items semantics apply only when the group is open (open !== false)
Readback wording is English by default; override the text props
a11y: Expand buttons use aria-expanded/aria-controls and an aria-label
Children are a role=group labelled by the parent
Readback in a polite live region
stops: Whole group ticked, future items included
